templates.promptPattern: Which time signature belongs to this rhythm? The choices mix regular and irregular signatures.

acceptance.alternativesNote: Exactly one signature fits: the other signatures offered hold a different amount of music in a bar.

ambiguityChecks: Only signatures with a different bar length are offered as wrong answers, so one answer fits.
At least one wrong answer is of the other kind (regular against irregular).
A bar with tuplets still holds a fixed amount of music: only signatures of a different bar length are offered as wrong answers.
hints: Add up one bar. Dotted beats or three beamed notes to a beat mean each beat divides into three; five or seven beats mean irregular time.

extraMistakeCategories.description: Counts the bar wrongly or ignores the beat unit.
extraMistakeCategories.feedback: Add up one bar in the value of the lower figure, then check the beat grouping.

templates.promptPattern: Which bar writes its rests correctly (compound or irregular time)?

acceptance.alternativesNote: One bar is correct. A dotted-beat rest and a rest followed by a smaller rest are both accepted in compound time, and neither is offered as a wrong answer.

ambiguityChecks: Exactly one option is correct; each wrong option writes one silent beat or group as several small rests.
The notes are identical in all three bars; only the rests differ.
In a two-group bar the silent units straddle the boundary: one rest for each is right, a single rest across the boundary is wrong.
hints: Each silent group or beat is one rest, not a row of small ones.
